en.html:
Kageaki"There seemed to be some disturbance earlier."
Chachamaru"Ah, that? Nothing serious. Just a sneak thief."
Chachamaru"Apparently escaped, though. Well, no great concern."
Muramasa"...This sneak thief. Not an enormously large monk, by any chance?"
Chachamaru"? ...No. What, you met that fellow?"
Muramasa"Briefly. A friend of yours?"
Chachamaru"Being asked that makes apun want to answer, 'Selling a fight, are you?' That sort of relationship."
Muramasa"You ought to get along. Equally unpleasant personalities."
Chachamaru"You really are selling a fight."
Muramasa"If you must be noisy during a meal, go elsewhere. It is tiresome."
Chachamaru"Whose house does this infantry armor think she is eating in..."
Chachamaru"So, did he say anything?"
Muramasa"Nothing. Merely treated us to a very irritating great laugh."

Muramasa frowned as she answered. Meanwhile, privately, I felt relieved. A small concern that the monk had caused the disturbance had refused to leave me. Apparently needless.

I was not a member of the Kubou's household. Even if he had been a hostile intruder, catching him was not my duty. Still, combining my position as a guest with his useful advice would have left the heart in a complicated place.

Advice.

————No-self.

安堵していた。

をずっと拭えずにいたが、杞憂だったらしい。

　俺は堀越公方府に属す人間ではなく、彼が敵意ある

などを考え併せると、心中は複雑なものになったろう。

　助言。

　――――無我。

en.html:
Muramasa"What objection to eating? I have taken the trouble to become flesh."
Chachamaru"Feels extravagantly wasteful."
Muramasa"Not entirely. The nutrients I take in can be converted to heat and stored, to an extent, in my core."
Kageaki"Is that so?"
Muramasa"Of course, compared with a real body, conversion efficiency is not very good."
Chachamaru"Actual figures?"
Muramasa"A whole bale of rice gives me about the heat an ordinary human gets from a small saucerful."
Chachamaru"Apologize! Apologize to the farmers! And never eat again!"
Muramasa"What? Leaving it would only waste it. That would be a shame."
Chachamaru"Throw it in the back garden for pill bugs, even that would contribute more to Spaceship Earth!"
Muramasa"Unpleasant, these people who line up sophistries merely to hurt somebody for no reason."
Chachamaru"APUN IS RIGHT! For once, not even morally flexible—RIGHT!"
Chachamaru"KITNA CHILLAUN!? How many times must I shout before this lunch is over, you rice-powered bloody BLACK HOLE!?"
Kageaki"..."

en.html:
Privately, I was not wholly opposed to the Kubou's view. Saying so looked likely to cause later trouble. I kept quiet.

Besides, practically speaking, even a slight increase in stored heat helped close the gap with Silver Star. Even one thin sheet of paper closer was effort we should not neglect.

Especially now.
When the my efforts could hardly be said to have produced even one sheet of paper's worth.

Chachamaru"By the landlord's authority, exclusion is hereby prohibited. Bullying is not a good look."
Chachamaru"Accordingly, bhai, what happened?"
Kageaki"...Well."

茶々丸 「なんかまた固まってたね。 　さっきから、どしたの？」
景明 「少々考え事がありまして」
村正 「……あのいんちき坊主に言われたこと？」
景明 「からかわれた節があるのも事実だが…… 　やはりあれは、忠告であり助言であったの だと思う」
村正 「…………」
茶々丸 「置いてけぼりです……」
村正 「ごめんなさい」
村正 「そうね、御堂がそう思うなら……」
茶々丸 「謝るだけかよ！ 　説明してくれないのかよ！」
村正 「貴方には関係ないもの」
茶々丸 「家主権限で、仲間外れ禁止を命ずる。 　いじめかっこわるい」
茶々丸 「というわけでお兄さん、何があったの？」
景明 「……は」

en.html:
Whatever her unknown intention, the Kubou of Horigoe supported Silver Star. Consulting her on how to fight Silver Star ought to be the height of nonsense.

But now I did not want to let even the smallest possibility go. Explaining it to another person might also put my own thoughts in order.

...In the end, I told her what had happened that morning.

ja.html:
真意が不明とはいえ、堀越公方は銀星号の支援者で
ある。
　その彼女に銀星号と戦う方法について相談するなど
ナンセンスの極みだろう。

　しかし、今はどんなに低い可能性でも逃したくない
心境だ。
　それに他人に説明することで考えが整理されるかも
しれない。

　……結局、俺は午前中の出来事を彼女に話した。
